decision.reason: The only prose evidence is a one-line changelog entry [ev-25aeb771ff2f]. It says extraContainers was added to the write pods and points to PR 11319, but it does not name the exact values path or describe any effect. The chart values artifacts [ev-6b828f5bc194][ev-72c19aa86056] show that write.extraContainers is already present in the source release's values, which contradicts "added" at this release edge, and the render check failed, so it proves nothing either way. To write the change and applicability aspects reliably, we need the PR or a chart-version mapping that shows when and where the key was actually introduced.
